children.text: CS2023 introduces updated computer science curricular guidelines developed by major computing organizations. Below is a draft summary of key focus areas and proposed updates:
Knowledge areas have been reviewed and reorganized to reflect modern topics in computing.
Core content has been minimized to allow flexibility, with a new KA Core designation for deeper study areas.
Programs are encouraged to select focus areas, enabling clearer definition of graduate competencies.
Ethics and societal impacts are emphasized throughout the curriculum via the SEP knowledge area.
Mathematics requirements have been adjusted to offer more flexibility while retaining rigor.
Professional dispositions are included and linked to specific knowledge areas.
A new Competency Framework supports institutions in defining local learning goals and outcomes.
Emerging topics like Generative AI are addressed to encourage innovation in teaching.
These revisions support the evolving expectations for computer science graduates and align with global educational trends.
The guidelines were developed collaboratively over several years by a diverse task force, incorporating community feedback, global representation, and multiple rounds of revision.
